title: Coefficient equivalences conjugate bounded-below direct image
statement: For a finite discrete commutative ring B, the explicitly constructed coefficient equivalences E_S and E_T, and a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism h:S to T, applying the internal derived direct image to E_S of a bounded-below pro-etale module complex is naturally isomorphic to applying E_T to the bounded-below module-valued pro-etale direct image.

proof.text: Reuse the proved encodingPushforwardNatIso construction in Sheaf.Paper.FiniteDiscreteRestrictionEncoding. It expands the common encoding and checks the sectionwise actions using coefficient-unit compatibility. Its type is internalLowerStar h composed with E_T.inverse isomorphic to E_S.inverse composed with moduleLowerStar h. Cancel the two equivalences with Iso.inverseCompIso and Iso.isoCompInverse to get moduleLowerStar h composed with E_T.functor isomorphic to E_S.functor composed with internalLowerStar h.

Apply the proved source-library rightDerivedFunctorCompMapDerivedCategoryIso to the exact target equivalence, rightDerivedFunctorNatIso to the underived comparison, and rightDerivedFunctorCompIso to the source equivalence, which preserves K-injectives. Replace the right derived source equivalence with its exact levelwise functor using rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory. This constructs the natural isomorphism R(H) composed with D(E_T) isomorphic to D(E_S) composed with R(I), where H and I are the module-valued and internal direct images. The latter right derived functor is coefficientDerivedLowerStar by definition.

At X in the bounded-below derived category, apply D(E_T) to H.rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompatibility.app X, then compose with the preceding natural isomorphism at the included object. This is exactly the stated objectwise isomorphism, with the unchanged coefficient equivalences and direct-image functor.

theorem finiteDiscreteCoefficient_directImage_conjugation [DiscreteTopology B] [Finite B]
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} (h : S ⟶ T) [QuasiCompact h] [QuasiSeparated h] :
    ∀ X : DerivedCategory.Plus (FiniteDiscreteProEtaleSheaves B S),
      Nonempty (
        (D((finiteDiscreteCoefficientEquivalence B eR G hG T).functor)).obj
            (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj
              ((R+(ProEtale.lowerStar
                (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} B)) h)).obj X)) ≅
        (coefficientDerivedLowerStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj B) h).obj
          ((D((finiteDiscreteCoefficientEquivalence B eR G hG S).functor)).obj
            (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj X)))
